## 🚀 How to Use

### For Temporary Files

**Location**: `/.github/tmp/`

```bash
# Place working files here during Copilot operations

tmp/processing-step-1-2025-01-22.json
tmp/analysis-working.json

# Delete after workflow completion
```

### For Permanent Reports

**Location**: `/.github/reports/`
